videos.title: Dil Bechara
videos.description: A love story involving two cancer patients, starring Sushant Singh Rajput and Sanjana Sanghi. Based on the novel The Fault in Our Stars' by John Green.

videos.title: Betaab
videos.description: Sunny Deol and his childhood friend Roma Amrita Singh fall in love with each other. But Roma's father Shammi Kapoor disapproves of their union and decides to separate them.

videos.title: Dhoom 3
videos.description: A circus performer turns to crime to avenge his father's humiliation, facing off against a relentless cop. High-octane stunts, emotion, and revenge collide in this stylish action thriller.

videos.title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
videos.description: A psychiatrist unravels strange events in an ancestral mansion haunted by secrets. As science clashes with superstition, a shocking truth emerges in this gripping psychological horror-comedy.

videos.title: Padmaavat
videos.description: Padmavati is happily married to a Rajput ruler until a tyrant Sultan, Alauddin Khilji, enters their life and calls a war on their kingdom.

videos.title: Andhadhun
videos.description: An inspiring tale unfolds where faith and destiny collide, testing hearts and guiding souls toward truth, sacrifice, and the eternal light of divine blessings.

videos.title: Drishyam
videos.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

videos.title: Parole
videos.description: After their mother's untimely demise, two estranged brothers who hate each other must reunite to perform her final rites.

videos.title: Guru
videos.description: Aditya, a boxer, sees potential in a vegetable vendor, Rameshwari, and decides to train her. However, the two do not get along due to the former's harsh training style and the latter's hostile nature.

videos.title: Saas Bahu Aur Sensex
videos.description: Binita relocates to Navi Mumbai with her daughter Navya after a divorce. New friendships lead them into the exciting and unpredictable world of stock market investing.

videos.title: Dhoom
videos.description: A fearless cop and a biker thief engage in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase through high-speed robberies. The stylish action film redefined Bollywood's love for speed, style, and attitude.

videos.title: Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna
videos.description: Dev and Maya, both unhappy in their marriages, become friends and support each other. While trying to fix their relationships, they unexpectedly fall in love, complicating their lives.

videos.title: Om Shanti Om
videos.description: A junior artiste in Bollywood films is reborn as a superstar. He exposes the murder of his love, a yesteryears' superstar.

videos.title: Kaabil
videos.description: This is the story of a blind couple who lived, laughed and loved just like everyone in this world. Until one day, a terrible tragedy struck.

videos.title: Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai
videos.description: Sanjay and Anjali secretly love each other, but Anjali's engagement to Rohit traps them. They must confront their true feelings before it's too late.

videos.title: Akira
videos.description: A fearless young woman stands up against a corrupt system after being framed for murder. Armed with courage and combat skills, she fights for justice in a society where power silences truth.

videos.title: Duplicate
videos.description: A lookalike thief and a simple man's identities get swapped, causing hilarious confusion and danger. Shah Rukh Khan's double role drives this entertaining mix of comedy, romance, and action.

videos.title: Noorie
videos.description: Yusuf and Noorie are set to get married but after her father's sudden death, the wedding is postponed. While work takes Yusuf out of town, Noorie is left to fend for herself from many evils.

videos.title: Dil Bole Hadippa
videos.description: A spirited Punjabi girl disguises herself as a man to join a cricket team. Her secret, determination, and romance blend in a lively story celebrating gender equality, passion, and self-belief.

videos.title: Mimi
videos.description: An aspiring actress in a small town agrees to bear a child for a visiting couple seeking a surrogate mother, but her experience takes unexpected turns.

videos.title: Housefull
videos.description: A man cursed with bad luck finds himself in a web of misunderstandings and chaos. With wild humor, love triangles, and situational gags, it's a full-blown comedy of errors.

videos.title: Raja Shivaji
videos.description: A young warrior's dream of forging a sovereign Maratha realm meets ruthless resistance as he defies the overwhelming might of the Adil Shahi Sultanate and the formidable Mughal Empire.
